MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "Standing Ovation feels like a natural next choice because stage songs connect directly with my enjoyment of Stages and A Musical Affair.",
    "Dream With Me fits the combination of expressive vocals and relaxing classical listening I want now; Celtic Thunder and Partners also sound worth sampling for their vocal performances."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Christmas albums connect with something I have enjoyed before, but seasonal music does not suit my current desire for relaxing, nonseasonal listening.",
    "Adele and Blake Shelton feel less suited to this moment because I am seeking theatrical or classical vocals, even though I have listened to other popular and country albums.",
    "Hope might fit, but I cannot confidently choose it from the title alone without knowing more about its sound."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My earlier Christmas listening seems to have been treated as an ongoing desire for more holiday albums.",
    "My interest in vocal music seems to have been extended too broadly: a prominent singer alone does not give me the stage-song or classical crossover experience I want."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My most recent relaxing classical selection matters to what I want now, especially when paired with my earlier interest in expressive vocal performances.",
    "The connection between Stages, A Musical Affair, and songs from the stage matters more to me today than my occasional country or seasonal listening."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly understood my taste for expressive vocals, but gave too much weight to past holiday listening and too little to my current preference for relaxing classical and theatrical music."
}
